_comment: Registry of per-app Expo Go dev servers (Variant B). Single source of truth for slug -> fixed Metro port. The shared dev-router (scripts/dev-router.js) reads this live to route <host_template> traffic to 127.0.0.1:<port>. Adding an app = run scripts/expo-qr.sh <slug> (auto-allocates the next free port here). host_template / dns_mode are set once, when the operator applies the one-time tunnel setup.
